trickyParts: jj writes nothing into an enclosing repository it merely opens when that repository's configuration is already migrated; the write the pod's read-only mount caught is jj 0.38+'s migration of the legacy .jj/repo/config.toml into the config home. The regression test plants that legacy file in its decoy for exactly this reason, and says so — without it only half (b), the state directory inside the decoy, would separate the fixed code from the broken.

jjWorkspaceRoot had to stop reading Command.Dir before any call site could name one: with Dir read as a workspace root, the two rootless commands would have gone through guardWorkspace into refuseSymlinkedLayout, which walks layoutDepth ancestors and would then Lstat the state directory itself, the one directory config.go:352-353 deliberately leaves unchecked.

feedTransfer.dir is never transfer.destination: transferWithRetries removes destination between attempts, and a child whose working directory has been removed cannot start. The GitHub clone therefore runs in the staging directory's parent.

The read-only guard the pod proof uses needs a user namespace: `unshare -Urm <script>` where the script runs `mount --bind /legion/repos /legion/repos` then `mount -o remount,bind,ro /legion/repos` before cd'ing and exec'ing. Inside that namespace the process is uid 0 with CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE, which defeats permission-bit isolation: internal/runtime/sandbox's TestWhatAnIssuePlantsNeitherReadsTheProvisioningTokenNorOutlivesItsPod hides volumes with os.Chmod(dir, 0) and so fails under the guard and passes without it, at this head and at the base alike. Run that package without the guard.

A third class of the same defect was measured live and is fixed here: every other git or jj child a daemon test starts with no working directory, nineteen sites in ten files, two of which (internal/shim/shim_test.go's `jj git init --colocate`) are the production defect's own shape. Three cmd/legion workspace-init tests failed with `jj: exit status 255` under the read-only guard until they were fixed.
The plan's design D1 refused an empty Dir. The refusal is one rule over an empty and a relative Dir, since a relative Dir resolves against the same process directory an empty one inherits.

discoveredComplexity: TestTmuxBootRewritesEveryOlderClonesCredentialHelper fails in a Legion issue pod at the base commit 4933464f, before this change: the pod's environment sets GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=5 with credential.https://github.com.helper twice (the empty reset and `!legion git-credential`), and `git config --get-all` lists the environment scope, so the test read four values of that key where the clone's file holds two.
